user_saw: Fresh provider setup in the Control UI threw "Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'variant')" when advancing from the API-key field to the endpoint compatibility choice.
summary: Replaces SingleChoice's whole-object createMemo of picker params with one stable object of reactive getters so the Picker never receives undefined params during step transitions (plus benchmark and wire-link simulator fixes).
reasoning: The whole-object `createMemo<PickerParams<...>>` was introduced by 0a32b78ba64 (#171882, Oct 15) and later reshaped by 4285c6ced42 (#191385, Nov 3, Continue-confirm flow for model-setup pickers with more than two options), while the Picker/select-picker internals that read `params.variant` changed in many commits since. The PR does not say when the transition last worked, and its own unit transition test passes on base, so I could not tie the undefined-params failure to the introducing commit, to 4285c6ced42, or to a Solid/picker change with a quotable line.
